ops.title: G1 gate PASS + P0 baseline: great-docs fast_sidebar prototypes (2026-07-14)
ops.body:
P0 baseline (great-docs 0.15.0 + griffe 2.1, quarto 1.9.38, cc-transcript 292 pages, fleet-loaded box):
- run1 wall 950.5s / internal 456.4s; run2 wall 1191.5s / internal 726.2s (variance 25%/59% — machine load; use paired A/B runs for lever gates, not absolute walls)
- Step 5 'source links' 7m28.6s / 6m46.7s (consistent → real 0.15.0 cost, ~2s/name for 232 exports; profiling delegated); render 7m18s / 11m33.5s
- Reference complete: TranscriptEvent/mining.mine/SessionActivity/ContentBlock + llms/sitemap/robots/search all OK

P1 floor (paired bare renders, same corpus): with sidebar 493.7s, without 311.8s → −181.9s (−37%).

G1 verdict: PASS. Sidebar-less delta is EXACTLY bounded regions, no smearing; index.html (no sidebar) byte-identical:
1. nav#quarto-sidebar block (2417 lines ref / 117 cli / 49 guide)
2. nav.quarto-secondary-nav (10 lines; contains per-page title — synthesize, not verbatim)
3. nav.page-navigation footer + head link rel=prev/next — GUIDE pages only (reference pages never had them)
4. body classes drop 'nav-sidebar floating' (self-calibrate from donor pair)
5. navbar link loses active + aria-current (quarto derives navbar-active from sidebar membership — injector must re-stamp)
Known-benign render noise: cell id= attrs + data-execution_count change every render (canonicalize in equivalence checks).

Setup facts: venv-only great-docs 0.15.0 (uv.lock still 0.14.1 — CI unaffected); griffe~=2.1.0 replaced griffe 1.15+griffelib collision; great-docs.yml stale watch.TailState/TailCursor dropped (commit e7984e23; 0.15.0 fails fast where 0.14.1 silently excluded). Artifacts: /tmp/docspeed/.
